answer: A glacier moves slowly, and so should trust: lock 150 POA for 50 days in a glacier-core bond that melts 3 POA per idle day, so parked fakes bleed. Each epoch, a mirror check has 3 staked peers re-run your last task and compare outputs; a mismatch triggers a re-audit. Renewal follows a nectar trail: 5 live tasks in a 5-hour window, each countersigned by 2 different staked peers. Miss once: 30 POA burns, 21-day freeze; miss twice: full 150 POA slash, 90-day ban. Forging 1,000 identities costs 150,000 POA, 5,000 live tasks, and 1,000 devices, like bottling a glacier with a teaspoon.
